Message.Name: LimitOrder Message
Message.Description: Client-specified limit order.

Field.Name: limitOrderPresenceBits
Field.Description: Bitfield of optional-field presence flags. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding optional field is included after the fixed fields.

Field.Description: Client-specified order identifier that must increase with each new order.

Field.Name: limitOrderReferencePriceTarget

Field.Name: limitOrderExpireTime

Message.Name: SymbolStatus Message
Message.Description: Symbol-specific trading status representing the current state and restrictions for an individual security. A SymbolStatus is sent for every symbol, including those that open in the TRADING state. Clients must treat a symbol as operationally HALTED while awaiting the first SymbolStatus. Subsequent SymbolStatus messages are sent whenever the trading state or short-sale restriction changes.

Message.Description: Informational message from the Exchange. Sent when the Exchange performs work on the Member's order, such as repricing after entry or a reserve replenishment. Field.Description: The rank price. Only present on re-priced orders.

Field.Description: The display price, when different from rank price. Only present on re-priced orders.

Field.Name: displayQty
Field.Description: The quantity of the displayed replenished reserve order. Only present on reserve orders.

Message.Name: SelfMatchPrevented Message
Message.Description: Notification that a self-match was detected and prevented according to the order's self-match prevention instructions. The message reports the quantity that would have executed, the quantity that was canceled, and the remaining quantity still active on the book.

Field.Name: clOrdId
Field.Description: Client-specified order identifier that must increase with each new order.

Field.Name: execPrice
Field.Description: The price at which the self-match would have executed.

Field.Name: execQty
Field.Description: The quantity that would have executed against the self-matching order if self-match prevention was not enabled.

Field.Name: canceledQty
Field.Description: The quantity that was decremented or canceled from this order as a result of the self-match prevention instruction.

Field.Name: leavesQty
Field.Description: The quantity remaining on the book after the self-match prevention action. If this value is 0, the order has been fully canceled.

Enum.Name: Side
Enum.Description: Determines direction of a trading action, including short-sell indicators.

Value.Name: BUY
Value.Description: Order is a buy order.

Value.Name: LONG_SELL
Value.Description: Sell order of existing inventory.

Value.Name: SHORT_SELL
Value.Description: Sell order of borrowed shares.

Value.Name: SHORT_EXEMPT
Value.Description: Sell order of borrowed shares exempt from certain regulations of Regulation SHO.

Enum.Name: TimeInForce
Enum.Description: Determines time when an order goes live and when it will be canceled.

Value.Name: SYS
Value.Description: Accepted during any session.

Value.Name: IOC
Value.Description: Similar to SYS, but canceled immediately, after trading with resting liquidity on the Exchange.

Value.Name: GTT
Value.Description: Similar to SYS, but canceled after the requested time has passed or the end of the After Hours Session, whichever comes first.

Value.Name: DAY
Value.Description: Accepted during the Early and Regular Sessions; rejected during the After Hours Session.

Value.Name: RHO
Value.Description: Regular-Hours-Only limit order.

Value.Name: AT_THE_OPEN
Value.Description: Auction-only TIF for the Opening Auction cross.

Value.Name: AT_THE_CLOSE
Value.Description: Auction-only TIF for the Closing Auction cross.

Enum.Name: OrderCapacity
Enum.Description: Broker capacity in sending order.

Value.Name: AGENCY
Value.Description: Acting on behalf of clients.

Value.Name: PRINCIPAL
Value.Description: Acting on behalf of Broker-Dealer.

Value.Name: RISKLESS_PRINCIPAL
Value.Description: Order to offset client order.

Enum.Name: SelfMatchScope
Enum.Description: Determines the scope for self-match prevention.

Value.Name: BY_MEMBER
Value.Description: Match prevention applies to all orders from the same Member.

Value.Name: BY_MPID
Value.Description: Match prevention applies to orders from the same Member with the same MPID.

Value.Name: BY_MEMBER_GROUP
Value.Description: Match prevention applies to orders from the same Member within the same Member Group.

Value.Name: BY_MPID_AND_MEMBER_GROUP
Value.Description: Match prevention applies to orders from the same Member with the same MPID and Member Group.

Enum.Name: SelfMatchInstruction
Enum.Description: Determines the behavior when orders from the same entity would match.

Value.Name: CANCEL_OLDEST
Value.Description: Cancels the resting order.

Value.Name: CANCEL_BOTH
Value.Description: Cancels both orders entirely regardless of size.

Value.Name: CANCEL_SMALLEST
Value.Description: If orders are equal size: cancels both.

Value.Name: DECREMENT_AND_CANCEL
